prompt.project_info: Create a high-fashion urban editorial portrait with red and burgundy luxury streetwear styling in a pure white studio.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features, sleek dark hair styled back with a polished wet finish, luminous realistic skin, and a subtle confident smile revealing generic removable diamond-style grillz. She wears a burgundy-red biker-inspired cropped jacket with a subtle abstract fruit motif, high-waisted baggy tailored pants, fingerless leather-and-technical gloves, gold hoop earrings, and a minimal metallic nose accent.
prompt.composition_elements: 16:9 cinematic medium close-up, 50mm lens, eye-level symmetrical framing with slight head tilt, one hand near the face in a controlled gesture, pure white seamless studio with no distractions.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-key studio lighting with soft frontal key and controlled fill, even skin tones, subtle highlights on lips, jewelry, jacket hardware, and grillz; luxury urban authority mood.
prompt.technical_specs: ARRI Alexa LF-inspired look, 50mm static camera, photorealistic magazine-quality detail, visible natural skin texture and microhairs, clean contemporary color treatment, no rendered text or logos.
